scope: AVG S2 navigation regression synchronization; existing Work owner and immutable WorldRelease reference; no product code, registry, schema, AI or media changes
hypothesis: Saved confirmation mounts lazy ProductProductionStudio; await its actual module evaluation before observing committed route. The earlier DOM-only wait did not resolve this case.
mechanism: After the confirmation click has been flushed in act, use vi.dynamicImportSettled inside a separate act. Local Vitest implementation waits module promises and recursively includes imports they initiate. Keep real Studio mounted.
preserved: real reference cache service and isolated database
no production or hidden retry assertions
patch:
--- before/tests/regression/R-AVG3-pending-navigation-ui.test.tsx
+++ after/tests/regression/R-AVG3-pending-navigation-ui.test.tsx
@@ -139,7 +139,11 @@
         expect(button('确认制作方案', '[aria-label="AVG 内容导航"]').disabled).toBe(false)
       })
       await act(async () => button('确认制作方案', '[aria-label="AVG 内容导航"]').click())
+      // The saved branch loads the real Studio lazily before the route can commit.
+      await act(async () => { await vi.dynamicImportSettled() })
       await settle(() => expect(location()).toBe(`/avg/confirm${query}`))
+      expect(await db.productProductions.count()).toBe(0)
+      expect(await db.worldReleases.get(source.release.id!)).toEqual(source.release)
     },
   )
 })
